{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of particular [[manifold]]s. See also [[list of geometric topology topics]]. For categorical listings see [[:Category:Manifolds]] and its subcategories.

==Generic families of manifolds==

* [[Euclidean space]], '''R'''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[n-sphere|''n''-sphere]], ''S''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[n-torus|''n''-torus]], '''T'''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[Real projective space]], '''RP'''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[Complex projective space]], '''CP'''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[Quaternionic projective space]], '''HP'''<sup>''n''</sup>
* [[Flag manifold]]
* [[Grassmann manifold]]
* [[Stiefel manifold]]

[[Lie groups]] provide several interesting families. See [[Table of Lie groups]] for examples. See also: [[List of simple Lie groups]] and [[List of Lie group topics]].

==Manifolds of a specific dimension==
===1-manifolds===

* [[Circle]], ''S''<sup>1</sup>
* [[long line (topology)|Long line]]
* [[Real line]], '''R'''
* [[Real projective line]], '''RP'''<sup>1</sup> ≅ ''S''<sup>1</sup>

===2-manifolds===

* [[Cylinder (geometry)|Cylinder]], ''S''<sup>1</sup> × '''R'''
* [[Klein bottle]], '''RP'''<sup>2</sup> # '''RP'''<sup>2</sup>
* [[Klein quartic]] (a genus 3 surface)
* [[Möbius strip]]
* [[Real projective plane]], '''RP'''<sup>2</sup>
* [[Sphere]], ''S''<sup>2</sup>
* [[Genus of topological surface|Surface of genus g]]
* [[Torus]]
** [[Double torus]]

===3-manifolds===

* [[3-sphere]], ''S''<sup>3</sup>
* [[Torus#n-dimensional torus|3-torus]], '''T'''<sup>3</sup>
* [[Poincaré homology sphere]]
* [[SO(3)]] ≅ '''RP'''<sup>3</sup>
* [[Solid Klein bottle]]
* [[Solid torus]]
* [[Whitehead manifold]]
* [[Meyerhoff manifold]]
* [[Weeks manifold]]

''For more examples see [[3-manifold]].''

===4-manifolds===

* [[Complex projective plane]]
* [[Del Pezzo surface]]
* [[E8 manifold|E<sub>8</sub> manifold]]
* [[Enriques surface]]
* [[Exotic R4|Exotic '''R'''<sup>4</sup>]]
* [[Hirzebruch surface]]
* [[K3 surface]]

''For more examples see [[4-manifold]].''
